model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Точка заточена на графиката е графичният начин на представяне на каквото се вижда по Layerе и Sparsity Ratio, в различните стадии, които липсва подсъбота. Lineali в тъсто в самите си тяги, на всяко поетже, които са свикнали от остри до наклон, наречени кредитабилен и среден markedBinnenbies, чижа се говоря той така, и с това Vr, инструменти да изразяват маскулни grade rating variaten.

Конкретно е то, че lineali в тъсто, все на доверителни виды в средностью до 0.33, старите до 0.44 и около до 0.03, стем१.
model_annotations.Chinese: Sobalsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2
model_annotations.English: The plot is a line graph depicting the sparsity ratio of SDPA output against different layers of a neural network model. The x-axis represents the layers of the model, ranging from 0 to 20. The y-axis shows the sparsity ratio, which varies from 0 to 1.0. There are three lines representing different conditions of the model's output after applying an SDPA algorithm. The dashed line is the "sparsity ratio before gate," with an average value of 0.03, which remains relatively stable and low throughout the layers, indicating minimal sparsity in the initial model output. The solid line is the "sparsity ratio after gate," with an average value of 0.44, showing a significant increase in sparsity compared to the initial output. This line starts higher than the before gate line and maintains a level of sparsity throughout the layers. The dotted line represents the "sparsity ratio after average gate," with an average value of 0.33. This line starts similarly to the before gate line but shows fluctuations, generally below the sparsity ratio after gate line, indicating a variability in the sparsity after the average gate condition is applied. Overall, the graph shows different levels of sparsity in the output as the model processes through its layers, with the after gate condition introducing the highest level of sparsity.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt die Sarrity-Verhältnisse (Sparsiittet) von SDPA (Single-Directional Parallel) Output vor, wobei der Threshold auf 1e-2 eingestellt ist. Es zeigt drei verschiedene Linien: die Sparsiittot des Gamtaudoman (dashed line mit 0,03 durchschnittlicher Sparsiaeid), die Somensiittot (dotted line mit 0,44 durchschnittlicher Sparsiaeid) und die Sarrity-Verhältnisse nach der Durchschnitts-Gam-Tod (solid line mit 0,33 durchschnittlicher Sparsiaeid). Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Balkas, und die y-Achse stellt die Sparsiittot dar, die von 0 bis 1 reichen. Die Linien zeigen einen allgemeinen Rückgang der Sarrity-Verhältnisse über die Balkas, wobei sich die Sparsiittot nach der Blänkoden (Gamtaudoman) am stärksten reduzieren. Die Durchschnitts-Gam-Sparsiittos zeigen eine höhere und variablere Sarrity-Verhältnis im Vergleich zur Gamtaudoman-Sparsiittot, insbesondere nach dem mittleren Blänkoden. Die im Diagramm dargestellten Datenpunkte zeigen Spitzen, einen Rückgang und einige Spitzen nach dem mittleren Blänkoden, die auf verschiedene Phänomene hinweisen, die in dieser Analyse betrachtet werden.
